name: Central Bumble Bee
desc: Central Bumble Bee (Bombus centralis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus centralis, the central bumblebee, is a species of bumble bee found in parts of Canada and the western United States. The species was first described by Ezra Townsend Cresson in 1864.
